mapper.sql: select navigation_id, menu_key, menu_name, icon, route_path, order_num, menu_type, status, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark from sys_site_navigation
mapper.select:
and menu_name like concat('%', #{menuName}, '%') and menu_key like concat('%', #{menuKey}, '%') and status = #{status}
order by order_num asc, navigation_id asc
where status = '0' order by order_num asc, navigation_id asc
mapper.insert: insert into sys_site_navigation (menu_key, menu_name, icon, route_path, order_num, menu_type, status, create_by, create_time, remark) values (#{menuKey}, #{menuName}, #{icon}, #{routePath}, #{orderNum}, #{menuType}, #{status}, #{createBy}, sysdate(), #{remark})
mapper.update: update sys_site_navigation set status = #{status}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = sysdate() where navigation_id = #{navigationId}
